content.introduction: The sources provide earnings estimates for several companies for the week of November 2-7, 2026. Companies like Corebridge Financial, Telephone & Data, and Under Armour have earnings estimates of $0.41, $0.11, and -$0.01 per share respectively. The earnings calendar also highlights Apple as a significant player with 56 companies reporting after the close on Monday, November 2, worth a combined $6.3 trillion, with $5.1 trillion attributed to Apple alone. The sources do not provide a definitive answer for all companies listed.
